Six more little
travellers.

The adventure is growing! Dolphintouch has prepared another six printed and laminated Travel Bug designs to join the worldwide Six Degrees of Kevin Bacon Challenge.

Some of the original little travellers have gone AWOL, but the spirit of the challenge keeps going. ♡

Meet the new six ↓Meet the original six
The next six journeys

A whole new set of possibilities

Each new tag carries the same mission: travel from geocache to geocache, connect people and places through film, television, actors, directors and filming locations, collect photographs and stories, and spread a little kindness along the way. Explore the front of each traveller below, or open its reverse to read the message printed on the back.

Handmade with a little love

These new trackable tags started out as designs printed and laminated at home. They may be small, but their mission is bigger than any one destination: share a story, make a connection and keep moving.

Foxes, dolphins, postcards, peaceful road trips and the world of movies are all part of the creative spirit of this second wave.

The hope is that every person who discovers a tag will add another chapter, a photo or a small act of kindness. Maybe one day one will even reach Kevin Bacon!

Tracking note: These six cards represent the new set, separate from the original six. Public links have been added for five of these designs; the campervan's precise trackable name and link are still being matched. Please check the identifying number on the reverse of each physical metal Travel Bug before releasing it. Live locations and movements are recorded on Geocaching.com.

A little reminder

It's not only about reaching a famous face. It's about all the kind people we meet on the way.
